pageDescription: Set up free shipping and flat-rate shipping, and jump quickly to the rest of your promotion tools. Every change saves automatically.
loadingDescription: Preparing your control panel with your current data.
freeShippingDesc: The customer gets free shipping as soon as their order reaches the minimum you set here.
freeShippingThresholdDesc: Maximum allowed is 100,000 EGP. The feature applies once the order reaches this amount or more.
freeShippingMessageDesc: Type {amount} and it is replaced with your threshold automatically.
previewNote: Exactly as the customer sees it at the top of your store
previewOff: Free shipping is currently off. Turn it on to see the message here.
previewZero: Set a minimum greater than zero to complete the preview.
hideTopBarDesc: Hide the quick-links bar (Start your order, 14-day size swap, Confirm order before packing) from the top of your store.
flatShippingDesc: One shipping price for all orders instead of per-governorate pricing.
flatShippingFeeDesc: Maximum allowed is 10,000 EGP. This price is fixed at checkout for all customers.
flatShippingWhenToUse: When should you use a flat rate?
flatShippingUseCase1: Best for stores with a fixed shipping cost regardless of governorate.
flatShippingUseCase2: If you need per-area pricing, keep this off and use the detailed shipping settings.
resetDesc: Restores every value on this page to its default.
resetModalBody: Free shipping, flat rate and the top-bar toggle return to their defaults. Your orders and products are not affected.
defaultFreeMessage: Get free shipping on orders of {amount} EGP or more
